result.markdown:
For a small company, I'd put **BambooHR, Employment Hero, and Rippling** at the top of the shortlist. However, the best choice depends on whether you need a complete HR management system, payroll, or simply an easier way to manage employees.

If I were choosing HR software for a company with 5–50 employees, these would be my leading options for 2026.

## Best HR software for small businesses

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. BambooHR**

(Best overall HR management)

Great for employee records, onboarding, vacation tracking, performance reviews, document management and reporting.

Best if you want a dedicated HR system that's relatively easy to use.

[Official website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best for Canadian and international consideration)

Offers HR workflows, employee onboarding, performance management, employee records and workforce management.

Worth considering if you want more than a basic employee database.

[Official website](https://employmenthero.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

Combines HR, payroll, employee onboarding, IT access and other business processes.

Particularly attractive if you expect rapid growth.

[Official website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

**4\. Gusto**
Best for payroll and basic HR in one system.

Particularly strong for US-based small businesses. Check Canadian payroll availability before considering it.

[Official website](https://gusto.com/)

Best budget-friendly option.

Covers employee records, leave management, attendance, onboarding and HR workflows.

[Official website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

## My recommendation for a Canadian small business

Since Canadian payroll and employment compliance matter, I'd actually narrow the shortlist to these three\:

| Software | Best use | Published starting price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Employment Hero (formerly Humi) | All-in-one Canadian HR and payroll | Payroll from \$7/employee/month |
| Collage HR | HR, onboarding, performance and payroll | \$14–\$18 CAD/employee/month |
| Rise People | HR, payroll and benefits | From \$8 CAD/employee/month |


Collage HR publishes particularly clear pricing, including its HR and payroll package at \$18 per employee monthly. [rankite.com](https://rankite.com/blog/best-hr-software-for-small-business-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.collage.co](https://www.collage.co/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.rippling.com](https://www.rippling.com/en-CA/blog/best-hr-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My first choice would be Employment Hero (Humi)** if you want one system to manage most HR responsibilities. I'd also demo Collage HR before making a decision.

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
